headline: 英國兩位藝文人物辭世
context: 英國演員兼編劇克里斯．蘭厄姆（Chris Langham）因胰臟癌過世，享壽77歲，他因在英國政治諷刺劇《The Thick of It》飾演笨拙的政府官員而廣為人知，2007年曾因下載兒童色情內容入獄。同一時間，英國社區藝術家約翰．瓦拉（John Varah）因心臟衰竭過世，享壽67歲，他一手催生了布萊頓（Brighton）冬至夜遊行「Burning the Clocks」等知名藝文活動。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Actor and writer best known for his role in TV’s The Thick of It who was jailed in 2007 for downloading child pornography The actor and writer Chris Langham, who has died of pancreatic cancer aged 77, starred as the inept government minister Hugh Abbot in The Thick of It, the BBC television political satire created by Armando Iannucci. During its first two series, he was at the centre of chaos as the secretary of state in the fictional Department of Social Affairs, finding himself outmanoeuvred by his own political advisers and civil servants. “Chris Langham is a master at acting the guy missing the point, out of his depth and striving to keep his head above water while sharks nibble his nether regions,” wrote the Sunday Times in 2005. sources.summary: My friend John Varah, who has died aged 67 of heart failure, was one of Britain’s most influential community artists. A cultural anarchist dedicated to creating festivals, parades and illuminated spectacles, he was an inventor as much as an artist, surrounded by coils of wire, soldering irons and improbable contraptions as he coaxed ideas into life. Over the years he created and curated a number of popular events, including the annual Burning the Clocks ritual in Brighton, in which, on the winter solstice, thousands of people walk through the city carrying handmade paper-and-willow lanterns containing their hopes and dreams for the year. thread_text:
英國演員兼編劇克里斯．蘭厄姆（Chris Langham）因胰臟癌過世，享壽77歲。他在英國政治諷刺劇《The Thick of It》裡飾演笨拙的政府官員休．艾伯特（Hugh Abbot）而廣為人知，2007年曾因下載兒童色情內容入獄服刑。另一位過世的是英國社區藝術家約翰．瓦拉（John Varah），他因心臟衰竭過世，享壽67歲，一手催生了布萊頓（Brighton）冬至夜遊行「Burning the Clocks」等知名藝文活動，被視為英國最具影響力的社區藝術家之一。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 9 月 8 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 英國藝文圈，一天內送走了兩位重要人物。演員兼編劇克里斯．蘭厄姆因胰臟癌過世，享壽77歲，他曾在政治諷刺劇裡飾演一位笨拙的政府官員，廣受好評；不過他在2007年，也曾因下載兒童色情內容入獄服刑。同一天，社區藝術家約翰．瓦拉因心臟衰竭過世，享壽67歲。他一手催生了英國知名的冬至夜遊行活動，被認為是英國最具影響力的社區藝術家之一。
